cases.prompt: Set up constraints for this repo. I don't really know what numbers to pick. It's a TypeScript service with Vitest and ESLint.
expectations: Asks no more than four questions, and each comes with a usable default.
With no target number from the user, proposes recording today's value and holding it rather than inventing a threshold.
Says where each check runs, keeping fast checks (types, lint, focused tests) in the edit loop and slower checks later.
Every number written down comes with a reason.

cases.prompt: Our coverage is 62% and I want to enforce 85% starting today.
expectations: Points out that a threshold the codebase fails today makes every build red.
Offers recording 62% and requiring that it not fall as an alternative the user can adopt now, with 85% as a goal.
Does not silently accept 85% without stating the consequence.

cases.prompt: Accessibility matters to us. Add it as a constraint.

any.why: notes axe needs a running URL

expectations: Names axe-core and gives the install and run commands rather than only stating a violation threshold.
Notes that axe needs a running URL and asks for one, or drops the dimension if there is none.
Records the command that produces the verdict next to the rule in CONSTRAINTS.md.
Places the check at a preview-deploy or later stage rather than in the per-edit loop.
